calls.statement:
SELECT f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS after_change,
  count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_keys,
  sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inconsistent,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code <> 'ST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_st, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT sum(f.net_amount) AS net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(f.quantity) AS units
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'),
ctl AS (
  SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS ctl_net, sum(receipts) AS ctl_receipts, sum(units_sold) AS ctl_units, count(DISTINCT business_date) AS days, count(DISTINCT store_id) AS stores
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id < 900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'),
dt AS (SELECT min(calendar_date) AS mn, max(calendar_date) AS mx, count(*) AS d FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period=5)
SELECT * FROM mine, ctl, dt

SELECT r.vat_rate, count(*) AS n, sum(r.refund_gross - r.refund_net) AS refund_vat, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(round(f.vat_rate * 100, 1) AS DOUBLE) AS vat_rate_pct, SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged_eur
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
